pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: POCHITA... I'LL PROBABLY GET MYSELF KILLED FIGHTING DEVILS BEFORE LONG.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: IF THAT HAPPENS, I'M WORRIED ABOUT WHAT'LL HAPPEN TO YOU.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: YOU MIGHT STARVE TO DEATH, OR MAYBE GET TAKEN OUT BY ANOTHER DEVIL HUNTER.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: I HEARD THERE ARE DEVILS WHO CAN TAKE OVER DEAD PEOPLE'S BODIES.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: IF YOU CAN DO THAT... THEN I'LL GIVE YA MY BODY...

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: AFTER I’M IN MY GRAVE, THE YAKUIZA’LL FORGET ABOUT ME. YOU CAN LEAVE THIS TOWN...

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: IT’D BE NICE IF YOU COULD HAVE A NORMAL LIFE
